lines.cap: This tiny machine beats 28,800 times an hour, and it’s never once needed a battery.
lines.say: This tiny machine beats twenty-eight thousand, eight hundred times an hour, and it's never once needed a battery.

lines.cap: It’s calibre 3235, the beating heart of a modern Rolex. So let’s turn it over, open it up, and have a look.
lines.say: It's calibre thirty-two thirty-five, the beating heart of a modern Rolex. So let's turn it over, open it up, and have a look.

lines.cap: Every move of your wrist swings the rotor, which winds the mainspring, storing about seventy hours of power in this little drum.
lines.say: Every move of your wrist swings the rotor, which winds the mainspring, storing about seventy hours of power in this little drum.

lines.cap: The gear train counts the time out, and the escapement lets it go, half a tooth at a time. Lock, release, impulse. That’s the tick you hear.
lines.say: The gear train counts the time out, and the escapement lets it go, half a tooth at a time. Lock, release, impulse. That's the tick you hear.

lines.cap: And keeping it all in time is the balance, swinging four times a second on a blue hairspring of niobium and zirconium.
